verdict.rationale: Simular's docs mention a "standalone simulang CLI" alongside simulang-js and a /simulang skill for Claude Code, so a first-party CLI exists and is tied to agent workflows. That is the only mention, though. The main Sai developer surface is listed as a REST API, Python SDK and MCP server, with no CLI, and the npx command is only an MCP-server launcher. Missing for 10: CLI command reference or install docs, coverage of the core Sai agent (cloud computers, tasks, approvals) from the CLI, clarity on whether the CLI is current rather than legacy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
